  (e : BlockMatrixVector.Roundoff m),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
    LE.le.{0} 0 u →
      BlockMatrixVector.Admissible n T u e →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T)) u) 1 →
          ∃ ΔA,
            And
              (Eq.{1} (BlockMatrixVector.computedVector A x T e) (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA) x))
              (∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n),
                LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔA i j))
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (BlockMatrixVector.gamma (BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T) u)
                    (abs.{0} (A i j))))

fun term err x =>
  Nat.brecOn.{1} x fun x f =>
    (match (motive := (x : Nat) → Nat.below.{1} x → Real) x with
      | 0 => fun x => 0
      | 1 => fun x => term 0
      | Nat.succ (Nat.succ k) => fun x =>
        HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} x.1 (term (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)))
          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 (err (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1))))
      f
